title: Synthesis and zero-dimensional structure of a new lead-free organic–inorganic[(C2H5)4N]3Bi2I9 compound: a promising material for optoelectronic devices
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10785-10797
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09365A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hanen Elgahami, Khawla Ben Brahim, Sondes Hajlaoui, Mona A. Alamri, Gwenaël Corbel, Abderrazek Oueslati
A new lead-free organic–inorganic hybrid compound based on Bi(III), namely tris(tetraethylammonium) nona-idodibismuthate(III), [(C2H5)4N]3Bi2I9, has been successfully synthesized using a slow evaporation technique.
